semantics.note: The normalization preserves the conditional consequence of failing to convert by year-end 2025. It does not predict that conversion itself will fail.

contract.note: The surrounding financing discussion grounds the interpretation of conversion. The consequence is undefined, but that ambiguity does not determine the result because the antecedent was not met.

evidence.note: This timely company disclosure reports completed recapitalization before year-end 2025. It addresses the antecedent, not the conditional outcome, so it does not contradict the forecast. It is not an independent finding.

output.rationale: OpenAI reported completing its recapitalization on October 28, 2025. Under the contract's reading of conversion, the no-conversion antecedent did not occur. The conditional therefore cannot be scored as either supported or contradicted, despite the deadline having passed.
